title: Editor dialog title wraps to two lines at large font
findings_note: S22 row 14 on API 36 at font scale 2.0 on 360dp: the editor dialog title is truncated to 'New …' by maxLines = 1 in ui/EditorDialog.kt. Owner chose maxLines = 2.
boundary: Not in this slice: other dialog layout changes or new strings.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: At font scale 200% on a 360dp screen the editor dialog title shows 'New …' because the title Text has maxLines = 1 with an ellipsis. The owner chose to let it wrap to two lines.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: None automated; observed in the S22 row 14 walkthrough.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Change the EditorDialog title Text to maxLines = 2, keeping TextOverflow.Ellipsis and the pinned Cancel/Save header.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: On API 36 at 360dp (wm density 480) and font_scale 2.0, the New tracker and Edit tracker titles show in full, and Cancel and Save stay visible with the keyboard open in portrait and landscape. testDebugUnitTest, lintDebug and the API 36 instrumented suite pass.
